verdict.rationale: Companies House runs a real public REST API: records have unique URIs and can be read with simple GET requests. A live probe got a structured 401 auth challenge rather than a bot wall, which fits a free API-key model, and there are documented authorisation and rate-limiting guides. That makes headless, read-only automation from scripts or CI feasible. Write paths such as filing accounts or changing addresses are only evidenced as web services, and identity verification is being added to them, so end-to-end headless automation of filings is not shown. The API is also still beta at version 0. Missing for 10: evidence of API-based filing or other write operations, CI-specific or headless automation guidance (CLI, SDK, service accounts), a stable non-beta API version, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
